_doc: Р59: the integrations from outside HA's core Hauflo may install on the integrator's click (install.py; the cloud's copy backend/src/ha/integrations.json is byte-identical, a test on each side keeps them so). Only these, only github.com: an asked domain or repository not listed here is refused. Per entry: repo (owner/name on GitHub), version (the release tag pinned, never «latest»), asset (the release's zip file) and sha256 (of that file, checked before anything is unpacked), zip_path (the integration's folder inside the zip, "" = the zip's root as HACS' zip_release has it), store (the category Marketplace / HACS keep it under — used first when HA has one of them), min_ha (the HA version the integration's hacs.json asks for), after (what the cloud does once HA runs it: alisa = its setup by alisa.ts). download: where the release asset is fetched from when neither store is there; after_restart: how often and how long the cloud asks the agent after the confirmed restart before it sets the integration up; hosts: the only hosts that download (and each of its redirects) may go to. Bump a version: download the asset, sha256 it, change both files.
